issue_frequency: weekly Sunday 00:00 America/Lima; first target starts next Monday
feature_rule: only observations and forecasts available at issued_at; never data acquired during the target future week
target: at least one NEW eligible fire onset within the region in the requested target week
evaluation_status: Frozen training and evaluation completed; see model reports
prediction_unit: Peru administrative region and specified future ISO week
internal_spatial_support: 10 km grid permitted for features; output is regional
target_semantics: physical wildfire initiation is the desired outcome; satellite first detection is a proxy requiring label validation
physical_probability_status: not established until target labels and calibration are validated
probability_aggregation: do not sum or average cell probabilities or assume independence; fit and calibrate regional target directly or validate a dependence-aware aggregation
regional_prevalence_check: if at least one onset is nearly certain in large regions during fire season, disclose saturation; expected onset counts or exposure scores may complement, never replace the requested probability silently
forecast_lead_definition: lead 1 is the next complete Monday-Sunday week after the issue date; lead 12 is eleven weeks after lead 1
lead_validation: evaluate and calibrate separately by lead; no guaranteed skill at 12 weeks
weather_lead_policy: short-lead weather forecasts only where supported; longer leads use verified seasonal/reforecast covariates or historical/climatological model, with explicit quality flag

label_pilot.label_definition: new detection episode, not verified ignition
label_pilot.source: original SNPP SP; not companion full-history static mask

NRT_ingestion_kind: one-shot original archive, not automated refresh
weather_spatial_support: one representative point per region, not areal mean
